data.name: Language
data.comment: The label of the language picker, read by screen readers.

data.name: NotFound
data.value: No such page. Go back to the {0}.
data.comment: {0} is a link to the overview page, with NavOverview as its text.

data.name: Days_Other
data.comment: A span of days, possibly with one decimal ("2.5 days").

data.name: JustNow
data.comment: How old a reading is, when the source's clock is ahead of ours.

data.name: UnderAMinute
data.comment: How old a reading is.

data.name: Percent
data.comment: A percentage; {0} is the number. Some languages put a space before the sign.

data.name: ModeSolarSummary
data.value: Charges from solar surplus the house isn't using, but only once the home battery is full.

data.name: ModeForecastedSummary
data.value: Charges from surplus like Solar, but the forecast decides how much of today's sun the car may take, so the home battery still reaches 100% by evening.

data.name: ModeSolarGridSummary
data.value: Charges from the sun. When the surplus is too small for the charger's minimum, the grid makes up the difference.

data.name: ModeFastSummary
data.value: Charges as fast as the installation allows, from the sun and the grid. The home battery is not used.

data.name: ModeTargetedSummary
data.value: Delivers a set amount of energy by a set time. Forecast surplus is used first; the rest is bought from the grid as late as possible.

data.name: ModeChange
data.comment: A session that started in one charge mode and ended in another.

data.name: WeatherLine
data.comment: {0} is a temperature, {1} a percentage of sky covered by cloud.

data.name: WeatherLineWithCondition
data.comment: {0} is the weather provider's own description (not translated), {1} a temperature, {2} the cloud percentage.

data.name: DayForecastLine
data.comment: A day's expected solar energy, with its pessimistic (p10) and optimistic (p90) bounds.

data.name: AboutTopic
data.comment: The accessible name of an (i) button that explains a figure; {0} is the figure's label.

data.name: SignInOnCarPage
data.value: Sign in on the car page

data.name: RestartProgress
data.value: Restarting… Charging is paused and the open session is closed. This page reloads by itself once the controller is back.

data.name: RestartNotBack
data.value: If it is not back within a minute or two, nothing is restarting it. Check {0} or {1}, or start it by hand.
data.comment: {0} and {1} are shell commands, shown as code.

data.name: RestartCost
data.value: A charge in progress is paused, and the controller starts again in Off, as after any start. The charging mode, a Targeted request and a Fast limit are not kept, so set them again afterwards. This UI and Home Assistant are unreachable for about half a minute. Starting up fetches the solar forecast, so a restart uses one of the day's Solcast calls when a key is configured. It restarts by itself under Docker's {0} and under the .deb's systemd unit. Run any other way — {1}, a plain {2}, the Windows zip — it just exits and must be started again by hand.
data.comment: {0}, {1} and {2} are configuration and commands, shown as code.

data.name: MqttBrokerNote
data.value: — the address the controller connects to; it may not be reachable from here.

data.name: MqttPasswordWithheld
data.value: set, but not shown — this UI has no login, so anyone on the network could read it. Configure {0} ({1}) to show it.
data.comment: {0} is an environment variable and {1} a command, shown as code.

data.name: SignInTitle
data.comment: The browser tab of the sign-in page.

data.name: SignInHint
data.value: One password for this installation, chosen on the Setup page the first time it ran, or set as {0}.
data.comment: {0} is an environment variable, shown as code.

data.name: SetupTitle
data.comment: The browser tab of the setup page.

data.name: AlreadySetUpText
data.value: This installation already has a password. {0}.
data.comment: {0} is a link whose text is SignIn.

data.name: SetupIntro
data.value: Gleanvolt shows this installation's energy and charging history and can change how the charger is driven. Anyone on this network can reach it, so set a password first.

data.name: SetupNote
data.value: One password for the whole installation, not an account per person. Next you get a recovery key, which resets it if it is ever forgotten.

data.name: PasswordsDiffer
data.value: The two passwords are not the same.

data.name: PasswordNotSaved
data.value: The password could not be saved on this installation, so it has not been set. Set Web__PasswordHash in the configuration instead.

data.name: DayMonthPattern
data.comment: A short day and date: "Wed 4 Nov". Czech would be "ddd d. MMM".

data.name: DayTimePattern
data.comment: A weekday and time: "Wed 14:30".

data.name: DateTimePattern
data.comment: A full date and time, for history and diagnostics.

data.name: DayDateTimePattern
data.comment: A short day, date and time: "Wed 4 Nov 14:30".

data.name: EvChargerStatus_SuspendedEv

data.name: EvChargerStatus_SuspendedEvse
data.comment: The charger has suspended charging.

data.name: VehicleSourceState_NeedsOwner
data.comment: The car's feed has stopped until the owner signs in again.

data.name: ListSeparator
data.comment: Between the parts of a short list on one line. Keep the trailing space.

data.name: TariffUntil
data.comment: {0} is the tariff and its price, {1} when it changes.

data.name: WeekdayAt
data.comment: {0} is a day of the week, {1} a time.

data.name: ChartDayMonthTemplate
data.comment: A chart's tick on a new day, as a uPlot template ({D} day, {MMM} short month). Czech: "{D}. {MMM}".

data.name: ChartLegendTimeTemplate
data.comment: The time under a chart's cursor, as a uPlot template ({WWW} short weekday, {HH}:{mm} 24-hour time).

data.value: The charger was switched out of Fast

data.name: DatePattern

data.name: RecoveryKeyIntro
data.value: If you forget the password, this key resets it from the sign-in page. It is shown only now: write it down or keep it in a password manager.

data.name: RecoveryKeyUse
data.value: Every change or reset of the password issues a new key, and the old one stops working.

data.name: RecoveryKeySaved
data.value: I have saved it, sign in

data.name: ForgotTitle
data.comment: The browser tab of the password reset page.

data.name: ResetDoneIntro
data.value: Every browser that was signed in has been signed out. This is the new recovery key, shown only now; the old one no longer works.

data.name: ResetNoPassword
data.value: This installation has no password yet. {0}.
data.comment: {0} is a link whose text is SetPassword.

data.name: ResetCodeIntro
data.value: Gleanvolt writes a one-time code to its log and to {0} on the machine it runs on. The code is never shown here: being able to read it proves you have access to that machine.
data.comment: {0} is a file path, shown as code.

data.name: RequestCode
data.value: Write a code on the machine

data.name: CodeIssued
data.value: A code has been written. It works once, for 15 minutes; asking again replaces it.

data.name: CodeTooSoon
data.value: A code was asked for a moment ago. Use that one, or ask again in a minute.

data.name: WrongRecoveryKey
data.value: That recovery key is not right.

data.name: WrongCode
data.value: That code is not right, has expired, or has already been used.

data.name: TooManyAttempts
data.value: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.

data.name: EnterKeyOrCode
data.value: Enter the key or the code.

data.name: ChangePasswordHint
data.value: Changing the password signs out every browser, this one too, and issues a new recovery key.

data.name: ChangeDoneIntro
data.value: The password has been changed. This is the new recovery key, shown only now; the old one no longer works. You will have to sign in again.

data.name: SetupModeTitle
data.value: Setup mode: the controller is not running

data.name: SetupModeIntro
data.value: Gleanvolt started without the settings it needs, so it is not reading the inverter or driving the charger.

data.name: SetupModeReady
data.value: Everything required is set. Start the controller to use it.

data.name: RestartManual
data.value: Gleanvolt is stopping. Nothing on this machine starts it again, so start Gleanvolt yourself to apply the settings.
